summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at enterprise scale. As of 2026, the lines have blurred: hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex/Gemini Enterprise, Azure ML) are now broad 'data intelligence' environments, while Databricks and others converge on the same territory. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require governance/MLOps at scale, or must manage many models in production; if you only need inference from an existing foundation model, a hosted model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini API) is usually cheaper and simpler than standing up a platform.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker (SageMaker AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/instance hour, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fees
platforms.best_for: Teams whose data and infrastructure already live in AWS and want deep AWS-native integration

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/instance hour plus storage; enterprise agreements available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises standardized on Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure OpenAI

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute, training hours, and prediction/endpoint usage
platforms.best_for: Teams on Google Cloud wanting highly automated pipelines and access to Gemini models (now folded into Gemini Enterprise as of May 2026)

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) on top of underlying cloud compute; enterprise contracts
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting a multi-cloud lakehouse/data intelligence platform unifying data, analytics, and ML with strong governance

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based paid tiers; enterprise licensing
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration layered on any training stack

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions available via Databricks
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle without vendor lock-in

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated ML and governance with low-code tooling for business/analyst users

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and managed platform
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting automated ML plus open-source flexibility and strong model explainability

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; infrastructure costs only
platforms.best_for: Platform teams building portable, Kubernetes-native MLOps pipelines without vendor lock-in

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing (GPU/CPU); free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Startups and teams wanting serverless GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infrastructure
